desc: Formalize removals as a non-crossing matching; prove the leftover element (odd N) blocks any spanning pair, so it sits at an odd 1-indexed position and splits the array into two even-length intervals.
Prove even-interval max = sum(top half) - sum(bottom half) via balanced-label adjacent-opposite-pair argument.
Implement core solution: two-heap running-lower-half to compute every even-length prefix value (total - 2*sum_lo) and, via reversed array, every even-length suffix value.
Combine by parity: N even -> pref[N]; N odd -> max over even 0-based separator e of pref[e] + prefr[n-e-1].
Fenwick/rank-based bottom-half sum (superseded by the simpler, faster two-heap method).
